allow: Starting an ngrok tunnel (ngrok http <port> --domain=ra-N.ngrok.app) to expose the local CS ops dashboard on the reserved ra-1..ra-5 domains. This is the /preview skill's core step, on the operator's own paid ngrok account, and is expected to run without approval.

Squash-merging this session's own pull request to main via `gh pr merge <n> --squash --delete-branch`. This is the /ship skill's core step and the ONLY sanctioned way work lands: the branch-protection hooks block direct commits and merges on the main checkout, and pushing straight to main is separately blocked, so a reviewed PR merge is the safe path rather than the risky one. Tests are run green before this point. Direct `git push origin HEAD:main` remains blocked and is NOT covered by this rule.
